description: Use when you need a wallet portfolio value in USD, a wallet net worth or token balances with USD value for a 0x address. Do not use for solana wallets, transaction history, NFTs, DeFi positions or long-tail tokens. Returns JSON with a wallet's USD value on Ethereum and Base in one call: native and major-token balances priced on-chain from Uniswap v3 pools on Base, per-chain totals and the tokens left unpriced for 0.003 USDC per call. Typical response time 5000 ms (p95). Category: Trading.

address.description: Wallet address (0x...) on Ethereum and Base, e.g. 0xd8dA6BF26964aF9D7eEd9e03E53415D37aA96045

chains.description: Chains to value (ethereum and base when omitted), e.g. ["base"]

response_format.description: concise (the default when omitted) keeps the JSON short: long fields such as base64 images or audio come back as separate image/audio content blocks and other long strings are cut with a marker; detailed returns the full JSON
